site.title: Ares Vallis · Pathfinder
site.instrument: IMP camera, APXS and Sojourner instruments

basemap.sourceType: Single-band grayscale CTX mosaic; colorized for display only
basemap.display: Warm Mars-tone color ramp applied to grayscale intensity

slope.method: GDAL Horn slope derived from MOLA elevation

roughness.method: 3×3-cell elevation range derived from MOLA elevation

aspect.method: GDAL aspect derived from MOLA elevation

terrain.caveat: MOLA MEGDR is gridded at 128 pixels per degree (about 463 m per degree of latitude; east-west ground spacing is smaller at high latitudes). These are regional terrain samples, not metre-scale hazards or a human-foot route safety assessment.

scienceCoverage.landingSiteContext: NASA mission / landing-site summaries. Landing marker location is published mission location; regional facts are context, not point measurements.
scienceCoverage.pdsTargetEncyclopedia: NASA/PDS Mars Target Encyclopedia associates named science targets with documents but does not supply coordinate-tagged point geometry for all targets.
